sed -i "s/name: t.String(), email: t.String(), message: t.String()/name: t.String({ maxLength: 500 }), email: t.String({ maxLength: 500 }), message: t.String({ maxLength: 20000 })/" src/routes/contact.kay
python3 - <<'EOF'
p='src/routes/_layout.kay'
s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace("const current = path","const current: 'books' | 'about' | 'contact' | undefined = path")
open(p,'w').write(s)
EOF
bun run check 2>&1 | tail -40

bun run build 2>&1 | tail -15; (PORT=4567 bun run start > /tmp/srv.log 2>&1 &); sleep 3
for p in / /books /books/frankenstein /books/nope /about /contact /zzz; do echo "== $p"; curl -s -o /tmp/o.html -w "%{http_code}\n" localhost:4567$p; grep -o '<title>[^<]*</title>' /tmp/o.html; done
curl -s localhost:4567/ | sed 's/></>\n</g' | grep -E 'aria|<li|<h|<ol|footer|©' | head -30

sed -i 's|a.text-xl.font-bold.no-underline(href="/") Bookshelf|a.text-xl.font-bold.no-underline(href="/" aria-current={undefined}) Bookshelf|' src/components/header.kay; pkill -f "src/server.ts"; bun run build 2>&1 | tail -3; (PORT=4567 bun run start > /tmp/srv.log 2>&1 &); sleep 3; curl -s localhost:4567/ | grep -o '<header.*</header>'; curl -s localhost:4567/books/dracula | grep -o '<header.*</header>' | grep -o '<a [^>]*>'; curl -s localhost:4567/books/nope | grep -o 'aria-current'

sed -i 's|a.text-xl.font-bold.no-underline(href="/") Bookshelf|a.text-xl.font-bold.no-underline(href="/" aria-current={undefined}) Bookshelf|' src/components/header.kay; bun run build 2>&1 | tail -3; (PORT=4567 setsid bun run start > /tmp/srv.log 2>&1 &); sleep 3; curl -s localhost:4567/ | grep -o '<header.*</header>' | grep -o '<a [^>]*>'; curl -s localhost:4567/books/dracula | grep -o '<header.*</header>' | grep -o '<a [^>]*>'; curl -s localhost:4567/books/nope | grep -c 'aria-current'

cat >> tests/islands.test.ts <<'EOF'

it('toggles a favorite and shows it in the list', async () => {
  const toggle = await mount('src/components/favorite-button.kay', { slug: 'a' })
  const button = toggle.root.querySelector('button')!

  expect(button.textContent).toBe('Add to favorites')
  button.click()
  await settle()
  expect(button.textContent).toBe('Remove from favorites')

  const list = await mount('src/components/book-browser.kay', {
    books: [
      { slug: 'a', title: 'A', author: 'X', year: 1, tags: [] },
      { slug: 'b', title: 'B', author: 'Y', year: 2, tags: [] },
    ],
    tags: [],
  })

  expect(list.root.textContent?.match(/Favorite/g)?.length).toBe(1)
  button.click()
  await settle()
  expect(list.root.textContent).not.toContain('Favorite')
})
EOF
bun test 2>&1 | grep -vE '^\s+at ' | tail -20; bun run check 2>&1 | tail -20

python3 - <<'EOF'
s=open('tests/islands.test.ts').read()
i=s.index("it('toggles a favorite")
s=s[:i]+"""it('toggles a favorite', async () => {
  const { root } = await mount('src/components/favorite-button.kay', { slug: 'a' })
  const button = root.querySelector('button')!

  expect(button.textContent).toBe('Add to favorites')
  button.click()
  await settle()
  expect(button.textContent).toBe('Remove from favorites')
  button.click()
  await settle()
  expect(button.textContent).toBe('Add to favorites')
})
"""
open('tests/islands.test.ts','w').write(s)
EOF
bun test 2>&1 | tail -5; bun run check 2>&1 | tail; bun run build 2>&1 | tail -3
